title: fix: settle the bee logo so every app can use one file
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Updated the horizontal Polli lockup in @pollinations/ui: the gap between the bee and wordmark grows from 8% to 19% of the bee’s height, and the wordmark sits near her feet instead of vertically centered. Regenerated the black and white PNGs at 1024 px wide and bumped the package from 0.1.0-alpha.17 to 0.1.0-alpha.18. Apps using the package asset can use the revised spacing without making their own copy.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli adjusts the spacing between herself and a small 'pollinations.ai' wordmark with a tiny ruler, beside lime green (#ecf874) code-plants. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny designer glasses and is small-to-medium in the scene, with no second bee. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites and a soft CRT glow.
